description: This PHP class 'MetaService' provides API endpoints for retrieving module and field metadata, as well as a Swagger schema, within the SuiteCRM/ SugarCRM ecosystem. It manages access control, constructs responses with module and field lists, and reads a Swagger JSON file.

classes.name: MetaService
classes.description: A service class providing API endpoints for module and field metadata, and Swagger schema retrieval within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: getModuleList
methods.description: Returns a list of available modules.

methods.name: getFieldList
methods.description: Returns a list of fields for a specified module.

methods.name: checkIfUserHasModuleAccess
methods.description: Checks if the current user has access to a specific module.

methods.name: buildFieldList
methods.description: Builds a list of fields for a module, pruning unwanted fields.

methods.name: pruneVardef
methods.description: Filters vardef fields to only include allowed fields.

methods.name: getSwaggerSchema
methods.description: Reads and returns the Swagger JSON schema.
